profile.summary: Collins Electrical Company, Inc. is an electrical construction and engineering contractor founded in 1924. It does design-build and preconstruction electrical work, solar and electric-vehicle charger installation, and emergency electrical maintenance for commercial, industrial and institutional customers across California. It is a union (IBEW) contractor with offices in Stockton, West Sacramento, Livermore, Modesto, Fresno and Marina.
